name: full-stack-fastapi-template
description: Audit check on a real repository: github.com/fastapi/full-stack-fastapi-template at commit f27b4721507824e57ebd0286ff1a84d82e83bf59 (FastAPI + SQLModel backend, React + TanStack frontend). Expected files and symbols were read from that commit by hand. The unanswerable questions name technologies the repository does not use. Run with: evaluate.py --project-id <id of the cloned project> --eval-set eval/eval_set_fullstack_template.json

questions.question: How are user passwords hashed, and which hashing algorithms are supported?
How is a JWT access token created and when does it expire?
How does the backend decode the bearer token and load the current user for a request?
What stops a normal user from calling admin-only endpoints?
How does login avoid leaking, through response time, whether an email address exists?
How is a new user saved to the database with a hashed password?
Which endpoint issues an OAuth2 access token after checking the email and password?
How does password recovery avoid revealing whether an email is registered?
How is a password reset token checked before the new password is saved?
How is the password reset token generated and how long is it valid?
How are emails sent and which SMTP options are used?
How can someone sign up without being logged in, and what happens if the email is already taken?
Can a superuser delete their own account?
What checks are made when users change their own password?
Which items does a user who is not an admin see when listing items?
How is the first superuser account created when the database is initialised?
What happens if a secret is left set to 'changethis' in the configuration?
How long are access tokens valid by default, and where is that configured?
Where does the frontend store the access token after login, and what does logout do?
How does the frontend decide whether the user is logged in?
Where is Sentry error tracking set up, and when is it turned on?

unanswerable.question: How does the app charge customers through Stripe?
Which Kafka topics does the backend publish events to?
How are WebSocket connections authenticated for real-time chat?
